title: Consider documenting `data-nosnippet` addition to cookie banner component
body:
<!--

  This is a template for any issues that aren’t bug reports or new feature requests. The headings in this section provide examples of the information you might want to include, but feel free to add/delete sections where appropriate.

-->

## What
Consider documenting the `data-nosnippet` attribute. It's not a breaking change, it's an improvement to the existing HTML, but people using the HTML for the cookie banner component will need to add this attribute manually.

## Why
In https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend/pull/2192 we added the `data-nosnippet` attribute to the cookie banner component.

## Who needs to know about this
Developers, Technical Writer, Content Designer

## Done when

- [x] Decided whether to document this change
- [x] Drafted content
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: This was included as a recommended change in the release notes for v4.0.
